raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice, at 02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-19, so it holds 666 rows with identical content per txn_id. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 318 txn_ids are doubled and every gold table is inflated. I dedupe silver on txn_id and keep the earliest delivery, which also corrects the gold tables downstream.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC, batch_id ASC) = 1"}}
